title: Multilinear extrapolation of compactness on mixed-norm spaces
summary: In this paper, we develop the Rubio de Francia extrapolation theorem for the multilinear compactness on mixed-norm Lebesgue spaces. More precisely, if a multilinear operator is bounded on weighted product spaces, then its compactness can be extrapolated from unweighted product spaces to the full range of weighted mixed-norm spaces.
